[ASSISTANT_SAID] There are several noteworthy historic sites to see in Kozhikode, including Kozhikode Beach, Mananchira Square, Thikkoti Lighthouse, Kozhikode Backwaters, Tali Temple, Kappad Beach, and Pazhassi Raja Museum.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kozhikode Beach is where Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama first set foot in India in 1498.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mananchira Square was built by the Zamorin rulers and later transformed into a public square by the British.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Thikkoti Lighthouse is one of the oldest lighthouses in the country and offers stunning views of the Arabian Sea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tali Temple is a 14th-century temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for its stunning architecture and intricate carvings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kappad Beach is known as the place where Vasco da Gama landed and is a popular tourist destination.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pazhassi Raja Museum showcases the history of the Malabar region.
